pull_request.title: Infrastructure: Synchronize session logs and exact token accounting
pull_request.head: codex/log-accounting-sync
pull_request.body:
Consolidate the available session journals and recover missing exact token observations into their canonical owners. The audit preserves all 95existing observations and adds 73missing completed turns:55 earlier attributed inventory entries and18 app turns. All 67historically pending-branch entries now appear exactly once with their original sources.

There are 145paired records and 168disjoint observed turns in 93records. All 35batch dry-runs passed before 35imports; records were reloaded before dated corrections. The 12older inventories are byte-identical, all counters reconcile, and no turn has duplicate ownership. Original science/native/source hashes, failed checks and DRAFT lifecycle are preserved.

The observed added counters are 184,140,580input / 177,345,152cached input / 949,739output / 298,423reasoning output / 185,090,319total. Cached and reasoning counts are subsets. These are partial client observations, not complete project usage or billing.

Remaining gaps are explicit in logs/usage/AUDIT-2026-10-07.md: 52records have no observations (including shared-owner cross-references and exclusions), 17older observations lack task attribution, the current cleanup turn is active, and the expressly excluded illustration/history turn cannot be split exactly. Internal Guardian reviews are outside user-task accounting because parent/aggregate semantics are unestablished. Execution model/client version remain null.

Two existing curated ACTS validation receipts are retained byte-for-byte under logs/evidence to repair branch-specific log links; the magnetic-plan link targets its original published revision. No scientific branch content is imported.

Validation: logger schema/pairing/unique ownership/counter arithmetic, 32logger tests, dashboard validation/build and full parent/main-relative whitespace checks passed. Primary log copies validate 145records after exact preimage guards; original branch, scientific files and Overleaf gitlink were preserved.

PR45 and PR47 were merged during cleanup. Their actual hosted merge commits are preserved in the receiving PR55 through an ordinary merge, with the illustration retained. This accounting PR is now stacked on PR55. Merge order: **merge this PR56 into PR55 first, then merge PR55 into main**. This PR changes curated logging and observed metadata for the three existing PRs only; it is excluded from scientific progress tracking.

Existing PR45/47/55 tracking entries are reconciled to their actual successful rebased publication heads. Original archived/source revisions, review targets and native execution hashes remain distinct and unchanged; no progress entry is added for this Infrastructure PR.

For this stacked setup, the child merges into the receiving parent before the parent reaches main. Earlier parent-first guidance is superseded; it would require retargeting children after each parent merge.
